description:
GammaLauncher Setup

A standalone launcher for vvvv gamma
Good evening y'all!

Here's another small one, with one improvement and one bugfix. Let's see what we have:

# New

• Uninstaller is now called with the `/SILENT` flag (same as batch uninstaller always did), thanks @azeno for the [PR](https://github.com/sebescudie/GammaLauncher/pull/116)!

# Fixed

• Fixes NPE in case no version was selected in the dropdow, which happens on a fresh machine, as reported by @catvvvveasel. Thanks for the [report](https://github.com/sebescudie/GammaLauncher/issues/117)!
